description:
Search the MedicalRecords.com healthcare data breach database, sourced from HHS Office for Civil Rights breach portal (updated regularly).

Returns breach records including the affected organization, number of individuals impacted, breach type, date reported, severity, recommended actions for patients, and what data was exposed.

Use this tool when a user:
- Asks if they were affected by a specific healthcare data breach
- Wants to know about recent healthcare data breaches
- Asks about breaches at a specific hospital, health system, or healthcare organization
- Wants to know what to do after a healthcare data breach
- Asks about the largest or most significant recent healthcare breaches
- Needs to understand what data was exposed in a breach and what risks patients face

Database contains 1,638 breach incidents reported to HHS. All are from official regulatory filings.

entity_name.description: Name of the healthcare organization to search for. Examples: "Ascension", "Change Healthcare", "UnitedHealth". Partial matches work.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Default 10, max 20.

severity.description: Filter by severity band: critical (500K+ affected), high (100K–500K), medium (10K–100K), low (<10K)

state.description: Filter by US state where breach occurred (2-letter code, e.g., "TX", "CA")

name: get_breach_incidents
